subject: Water safety campaign
statement: The health ministry has launched a campaign reminding residents to drink water regularly during the current heatwave.

subject: Swimming safety
statement: Swimming in rivers and lakes is discouraged where there is no lifeguard, and several sites have been marked with warning signs.

subject: Heat exhaustion cases
